# Please donate us a few beers

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_62_nukaknights-post-spenden-paypal-buymeacoffee.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Buy me a coffee or Paypal (below)

Every month we invest countless hours in Nuka Knights to keep you up to date and advance projects like the website. So you are always informed about all current topics and insider news in Fallout 76.

Since our time, the server and everything else in this world always costs money, we are always happy about individual or monthly donations. To do this, you can simply click on our “Buy my a Beer” button and support us. The button is located next to each article (mobile below) and at the bottom right of the page (the coffee mug button).

![](/uploads/yellow-button.png)

![](/uploads/selection-2260.png)

![](/uploads/selection-2261.png)

## Paypal donations

If you prefer to use Paypal, you can now also donate to us via Paypal.

![](/uploads/btn-donate-lg.gif)

By the way, with Paypal you can donate both with Paypal itself and simply with your debit card (normal EC card) or credit card.

![](/uploads/selection-2376.png)

## Merchandising

As an alternative to donating via Paypal or Buy me a Coffee, you can also buy something in our merchandising shop. We then receive part of it as a donation. At the same time you get cool clothes. In addition to our logo, we also have many other funny Fallout motifs and slogans in the shop.

Take a look: **Nuka Knights Merchandising Shop**
